scripts.test:py:coverage: python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests_py -p "test_*.py" && python -m coverage report -m
scripts.test:py:coverage-check: python -m coverage run -m unittest discover -s tests_py -p "test_*.py" && python -m coverage report --include=reporting_service.py --fail-under=82 -m
scripts.test:gate:local: npm run test:gate:js && npm run test:gate:py && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:gate:release: npm run test:gate:local && npm run test:e2e:staging
scripts.test:all: npm run test:js && npm run test:py
scripts.coverage:check: npm run test:gate:js && npm run test:gate:py
